name: Browser Session
description: Open a browser session. Choose Chromium for headless scraping, WebView for visible/interactive, or HTTP for plain fetch.
doc:
Modes:
• Chromium (default) - bundled native engine via CDP. Best for scraping at scale.
• WebView - Tauri's embedded browser panel. Visible and interactive.
• HTTP - plain fetch, no JavaScript.

Features:
• Optional proxy (static or from Mobile Proxy)
• Per-session profile, persistable across runs
• Custom user agent and viewport
• Block resource types (image, font, media, stylesheet, script) for faster scraping
• Initial cookies and headers
• Stealth: inject fingerprint overrides for basic bot evasion

For sites with strong bot detection (Cloudflare Turnstile, hCaptcha): use stealth + headless:false + persistent profile, then warm cookies by navigating manually once before automating.

outputs.name: Session
outputs.description: Session handle for downstream Browser Page / Extract / Action nodes

properties.name: Headless
properties.description: Run Chromium without a visible window

properties.name: Profile
properties.description: Profile name. Same name reuses cookies/storage when Persist Profile is on.

properties.name: Persist Profile
properties.description: Keep profile data dir between runs

properties.name: User Agent
properties.description: Custom user agent. Empty = engine default.

properties.name: Block Resources
properties.description: Resource types blocked at the network layer for faster scraping

properties.name: Initial Headers
properties.description: JSON map of headers added to every request

properties.name: Initial Cookies
properties.description: JSON map of cookie name/value pairs (or array of cookie objects)

properties.name: Stealth
properties.description: Inject fingerprint overrides (navigator.webdriver=undefined, fake chrome global, plugins, WebGL/canvas/audio noise, WebRTC IP block). Beats most non-Turnstile bot checks.

properties.name: TLS Impersonate
properties.description: HTTP-mode only. Speak real Chrome TLS ClientHello + HTTP/2 SETTINGS on the wire (BoringSSL). Defeats JA3/JA4 bot scoring at the network layer.
